title: OpenAPI security schemes
description: OpenAPI 3.1.1 and SDK engineering: checked-in contract, executable assertion, red starter, instructor fix and compatibility/security limitations.
objectives: Declare bearer authentication as an HTTP security scheme, require it on protected operations, and mark health explicitly public.
Repair the broken openapi-bearer-schemes contract exercise.

rubric: I understand the OpenAPI contract behind openapi security schemes.
